name: Match It: Picture Merge Puzzle VR
summary: Relax and challenge your mind in an immersive VR puzzle experience. Drag, sort, and merge pieces to complete beautiful images across smart and engaging levels. This relaxing puzzle game improves focus, logic, IQ, and problem-solving skills while delivering satisfying gameplay. Enjoy smooth, hands-on controls, brain challenges, and rewarding progression. Use helpful powerups to solve tricky puzzles and master each level. Perfect for fans of casual, logic, and brain training games in VR.
